all brownies contain:
sugar, butter, eggs, flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), unsweetened belgian chocolate, baking powder (calcium acid phosphate, bicarbonate of soda, cornstarch).

caramel includes caramel (sugar, corn syrup, liquid sugar, skim milk, palm oil, butter, salt, mono & diglycerides, natural flavor, soy lecithin).
chocolate chip includes semi-sweet chocolate chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, vanilla beans).
coconut includes coconut chips, coconut extract (coconut extract, ethyl alcohol, agave syrup, citric acid).
cream cheese includes cream cheese (pasteurized milk & cream cheese culture, salt, stabilizers).
espresso nib includes cocoa nibs, coffee extract (coffee, ethyl alcohol, agave syrup).
mint chocolate includes semi-sweet chocolate chips, canola oil, peppermint oil.
original has no additional ingredients.
pecan includes pecan halves.
raspberry swirl includes raspberry compound (sugar, raspberries, glucose syrup, red grape juice, citric acid, natural flavorings & pectin).
toffee crunch includes toffee bar pieces (sugar, palm oil, butter, almonds, salt, artificial flavors, soy lecithin).
walnut includes walnut pieces.
white chocolate includes white chocolate chips (sugar, cocoa butter, whole & skim milk powder, butteroil, soy lecithin, vanilla extract).
